notes.title: Friday patch day
notes.content:
Fix small issue in achievement
deactivate slope in VeloDrome, to enjoy the ride.
Add Trainer Resistance to give a cruise control for Arcade mode
Some visual fixes.

notes.title: Added achievements and leaderboard
notes.content:
Added 15 Achiements for testing and include steam leaderboard with XP.
You earn XP for Kilometer and Achievements.

notes.title: Changes and fixes June 2025
notes.content:
Added fixes 
Trainer Mode with S key now working (SIM / ERG(150W) / FREE )
release bigger scenes to ride
insert a FPS counter with STRG + F10 or F11
restrict slope to +-20%

notes.title: Pre Update
notes.content:
Simulation mode sends slope to trainer

hard to read bpm and power color texts are switched to color change of the icon

add ESC key to Pause/Exit Menu

User can set laps to ride

improve pairing and auto connect to known device

velodrome last/best lap timer.

velodrome is forced to arcade mode.

quality is now adjustable.

In the regular update at the weekend more fixes and more well placed objects.
